about: Original Prusa i3 MK3 / MK3S / MK3S+ (Printables 563056, 00Fusion360Export.step, sha256 c2ea1caf...). CAD frame: Z up, the LCD at CAD -Y (the front), the X rods along CAD X, the Y rods along CAD Y. Bed = Y (the Y-axis assembly's moving components: heatbed, carriage, bearings, belt holder); gantry = Z (the X-axis assembly: X-end motor and idler, X rods, Z nuts); head = X and Z (the extruder assembly rides the X rods and climbs with the gantry). The model names its own assemblies, so the rules are by name.
looks_about: The STEP carries no colours. Printed parts orange, the frame and the heatbed black, as on the real machine.
